lines.text: The arrogant rise against me, O God;
a band of ruthless men seeks my life;
they have no regard for You.
But You, O Lord, are a compassionate and gracious God,
slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion and faithfulness.
Turn to me and have mercy;
grant Your strength to Your servant;
save the son of Your maidservant.
Show me a sign of Your goodness,
that my enemies may see and be ashamed;
for You, O LORD, have helped me and comforted me.

pictures.scene: Anthony van Dyck, The Capture of Christ — the torches and the armed men closing in on Him in the dark, the arrogant rise against me O God, a band of ruthless men seeks my life
pictures.name: pd_dyck_gevangenneming

pictures.scene: Meester van de Barmhartige Samaritaan, De barmhartige Samaritaan — the stranger lifting the beaten man onto his own beast, they have no regard for You, but You O Lord are a compassionate and gracious God
pictures.name: pd_samaritaan_meester

pictures.scene: Joseph Anton Koch, Landschaft mit Ruth und Boas — the gleaner left to gather freely in the rich man's field, slow to anger abounding in loving devotion and faithfulness, turn to me and have mercy
pictures.name: pd_koch_ruth

pictures.scene: Guercino, Rest on the Flight into Egypt — the mother holding her son safe on the road out of danger, grant Your strength to Your servant, save the son of Your maidservant
pictures.name: pd_guercino_vlucht

pictures.scene: Karl Millner, Partenkirchen in Bavaria at Sunrise — the valley taking the sun over the dark ridge, show me a sign of Your goodness, that my enemies may see and be ashamed
pictures.name: pd_millner_partenkirchen

pictures.scene: Anna Ancher, Harvesters — the reapers walking through the ripe corn in the summer light, for You O LORD have helped me and comforted me
pictures.name: pd_ancher_hostfolk
